verified.catalyst: FDA action on the ivonescimab + chemo BLA for EGFRm non-squamous NSCLC after TKI, PDUFA 2026-11-14. The filing rests on HARMONi PFS. The primary OS read missed (HR 0.79, p=0.057); later cuts show HR 0.78 (nominal p=0.033, Sep-2025) and HR 0.76 (Jun-2026 cut), with no CI or p-value disclosed.
verified.dated_milestone: PDUFA 2026-11-14. Next date: Q3 earnings around 2026-10-22. No AdCom scheduled as of 2026-10-12. Watch also for a detailed OS presentation (CI and p-value) at an upcoming medical meeting.
verified.instrument: SMMT common (Nasdaq), ~$17.59, market cap ~$14.0B. A defined-risk options structure into the 11-14 date would fit better than outright stock, given the roughly symmetric binary.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named counterparty: FDA, with a fixed PDUFA date) and G2 (concrete dated regulatory commitment). G3 fails: there is no specific unpriced figure. A label in the 2L EGFRm niche is small next to a $14B cap that already prices the global ivonescimab franchise (HARMONi-3/-7). Approval mainly removes overhang.
verified.edge: L. We have no informational edge on an OS-dependent FDA judgement. The later OS cuts (HR 0.76-0.78, nominal p≈0.03) are public, and the missing CIs/p-value mean the market sees the same ambiguity the FDA does. Run-up from pre-catalyst base: about 0% to slightly negative. The stock was in the high teens to $20s around the Jan-2026 BLA acceptance, peaked at $29.23, fell about 13% on the Q2 ATM raise, and is now $17.59, up about 14% from its 50-day average of $15.46. So the event is not harvested on price. Remaining: about +25% to an approval value near $22, and about −35-40% to a CRL value near $11 (near the $12.07 52-week low). At roughly coin-flip approval odds, the expected value is at or below spot.
verified.primary_source: Summit 8-K / press release 2026-07-22 (updated HARMONi OS, HR 0.76, Jun-2026 cut, PDUFA 2026-11-14), sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001599298/000159929826000058. BLA acceptance PR on BusinessWire 2026-01-29. FMP quote 2026-10-12 ($17.59, 52-week range $12.07-$29.23, market cap $14.03B).
verified.analysis: This is a real, dated, forward binary with no AdCom found. The FDA earlier said OS is key, and the July-2026 update (HR 0.76, both ITT and Western) was sent to the agency without a disclosed p-value or CI. That is the crux, and no outside party can resolve it before the date. The payoff looks asymmetric to the downside: a CRL hits the franchise narrative, while approval of a narrow 2L label adds little to a $14B valuation. The FDA's treatment of the OS data cannot be verified ahead of time, and the triage's "$500M raise" did not reconcile: the filings show a $380M ATM alongside Q2. Keep it on WATCH for the OS detail release and the Q3 call, not ACTIVE.

verified.catalyst: FDA action on the MOLBREEVI (molgramostim) BLA for autoimmune PAP, PDUFA Nov 22 2026, with the UK MHRA decision (150-day accelerated assessment) also due in Q4 2026.
verified.dated_milestone: FDA PDUFA 2026-11-22 (extended 3 months from 2026-08-22 because of a major amendment). MHRA decision Q4 2026. EMA/CHMP Q1 2027. A $75M RTW royalty tranche funds on FDA approval.
verified.instrument: SVRA common (NASDAQ). Optional: defined-risk call spread into Nov 22 to cap the CRL gap.
verified.bloom_gates: G1 named counterparty: FDA (PDUFA), MHRA and EMA, plus RTW Investments, whose $75M royalty funding is contingent on approval. G2 concrete commitment: statutory PDUFA goal date of 2026-11-22. G3 partial: the $75M approval-contingent tranche is a specific figure, but the approval value itself is derived, not contractual.
verified.edge: M. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base (~$3.45 in early Oct 2025, before the BLA resubmission was accepted) to $4.92 is about +43%. That is partly a re-rate, but the stock has since fallen about 18% YTD (from $6.03 on 12/31/25) and is below its 50-day ($5.32) and 200-day ($5.49) averages and its $7.01 52w high, so the binary has been de-rated, not bid up. Remaining capture: about +40-55% to my own approval value of ~$7-7.5. I did not use the ~$11 consensus target. My figure is a rare-disease launch re-rate on a ~$1.0B cap with ~205M shares, against ~$200M cash at Q2 less burn and a royalty encumbrance on revenue. A CRL would mean roughly -45-50% (~$2.5, about 1x cash plus residual EU/UK value). At ~75-80% approval odds the probability-weighted value is ~$6.3-6.5, about +30%. Event quality is real, but the setup is a symmetric-ish binary, not an asymmetric one.
verified.primary_source: Savara Q2 2026 results PR (2026-08-11, s205.q4cdn.com) and 10-Q for the period ended 2026-06-30 (sec.gov 000119312526344585): PDUFA 2026-11-22, MHRA Q4 2026, EMA Q1 2027, $75M RTW tranche on approval. MHRA acceptance PR 2026-04-07 (BioSpace). FMP quote and EOD history as of 2026-10-09.
verified.kill_fact: Confirmed from company releases: the PDUFA date is 2026-11-22, which is the original 2026-08-22 date pushed back three months because the FDA classed the info-request responses as a major amendment. Priority Review was kept, and the Day-74 letter said no AdCom is planned. The MHRA accepted the MAA on 2026-04-07 under 150-day accelerated review, with a decision expected in Q4 2026. The EMA decision is expected in Q1 2027. Company press releases since the Q2 report on 2026-08-11 show no FDA or MHRA action, so the event is still forward and unfired. The FMP quote is $4.92, with a market cap of about $1.0B, a 52-week range of $3.35-$7.01, and the price below both its 50-day ($5.32) and 200-day ($5.49) averages. That is not harvested, and the price sits well under the stale-but-indicative consensus of about $9-11. Corrections: (a) I could not confirm that the extension was announced in April 2026; my searches only surfaced it in the 2026-08-11 Q2 release, so treat the announcement date as unverified. (b) The content of the major amendment has never been disclosed. This program's only prior deficiency was CMC (the 2024 RTF), and drug substance has since moved to a new manufacturer, FUJIFILM. An undisclosed amendment to a CMC-sensitive biologic is a real CRL tail, not a footnote. (c) Third-party commentary notes there was no 8-K for the BLA acceptance, the priority review or the extension. That is a disclosure-quality flag, not a disqualifier. (d) The numerator is unmodeled. The +40-55% on approval is a rough guess anchored to analyst targets, with no deduction for the RTW royalty/term-loan take or for the launch-financing dilution a clinical-stage company typically needs after approval. Under the provenance rule, that cuts the score from 6 to 5.
verified.analysis: Verified: PDUFA is 2026-11-22 after the FDA classed Savara's information-request responses as a major amendment (announced April 2026, reaffirmed in the Q2 results on 2026-08-11). The MHRA accepted the MAA under accelerated 150-day review on 2026-04-07 with a Q4 2026 decision, and no FDA or MHRA decision has been reported as of 2026-10-12. The event is forward, dated, not fired and not macro. The price ($4.92 per FMP 2026-10-09) has drifted down from $6+ into the date, so residual capture is still substantial (+40-55% on approval), not harvested. Gaps: I did not re-read the Q2 10-Q for the exact term-loan balance or RTW royalty terms, and the approval value is my rough estimate, not a modeled launch curve. This program already had a 2024 refusal-to-file on CMC, so a CRL tail is not negligible, which keeps the score at 6 rather than higher.

The only upside beyond the spread would be a topping bid from the unnamed strategic party, whose non-binding proposal arrived Sep 2.
verified.dated_milestone: Amended agreement signed 2026-10-01; FTC already cleared. Next: Synaptics shareholder vote (date not yet set, proxy pending) and the remaining non-US approvals. Close targeted by mid-2027.
verified.instrument: SYNA common (long) at $119.82, against the $123 cash consideration
verified.bloom_gates: G1 (named acquirer onsemi; the rival bidder is unnamed) + G2 (signed amended merger agreement, Morgan Stanley's committed ~$2.45B debt financing, no financing condition). G3 fails: the $123 figure is now almost fully priced.
verified.edge: L. Run-up from the pre-catalyst base of $106.15 (close before the Oct 1 announcement) to $119.82 is +12.9%. Remaining from $119.82 to $123 contractual is +2.65% gross over ~8-9 months, roughly 3.5-4% annualized, which is at or below T-bills for a deal still needing a shareholder vote and foreign approvals. The rival bid is non-binding, undisclosed and unnamed, and the board unanimously chose a LOWER onsemi price over it, so a topping bid is speculative. If the deal breaks, the stock likely drops back toward its 50-200 day averages of about $100-102, a 15-17% loss, against about 2.7% of upside. Mostly harvested, so the score is capped at 4.
verified.primary_source: onsemi/Synaptics joint release 'onsemi and Synaptics Announce Revised Merger Agreement' (onsemi.com newsroom + SEC 8-K/DEFA14A ex99-1, CIK 817720), 2026-10-01; Finviz/Benzinga reaction 2026-10-02 (prior close $106.15 → $120.76 premarket); FMP quote 2026-10-12 ($119.82)
verified.analysis: The event is real and well underwritten: cash price, committed financing, no financing condition, FTC already cleared. But the market priced it on Oct 2 (+13.8% to ~$120.76), and today's 2.65% gross spread over a ~mid-2027 close pays below the risk-free rate for real break risk (shareholder vote, foreign reviews). This is a revised-down deal: the competing approach cut the price from ~$7B to $5.7B, so the 'topping bid' framing in the triage note is inverted. Re-score only if the unnamed strategic party goes public with a binding bid above $123 or the spread widens past ~6-8%. Gaps: I did not find the original June per-share value or the pre-June undisturbed price, and the vote date is not yet set. No numerator re-derivation was needed, since this is a contractual cash price and exempt.
